name: freshworks-dev-tools
description: Freshworks Platform 3.0 app development, AI Actions integrations, publishing, and FDK management skills. Bundles MCP config (**.mcp.json** at repo root) — on install you will be prompted for your Developer Portal JWT.

interface.shortDescription: FDK setup, Platform 3.0 apps, AI Actions, and marketplace publish.
interface.longDescription: Aggregate plugin for Freshworks marketplace development: install and manage FDK with fw-setup, build full apps with fw-app-dev, AI Actions integrations with fw-ai-actions-app, and publish with fw-publish via MCP. MCP template: **.mcp.json** at repository root; configure Marketplace API token when prompted.

mcp_auth_token.title: Marketplace API token (JWT)
mcp_auth_token.description: API key from https://developers.freshworks.com/developer/ — API key for Freddy AI Copilot for VS Code plugin & AI Developer Tools. → Connect to Developer MCP server → Copy.
